title: Operando observing hydrogen evolution in commercial lithium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02940F, Paper
Yuan Wang, Shuyan Guo, Yuntian Guo, Peng Zhang, Guoming Ma, Dingguo Xia, Hao Zhao
Operando monitoring of the H2 evolution within lithium-ion batteries is essential for decoding their thermal runaway mechanism and preventing fires. Here, we track the H2 evolution over multiple charging‒discharging cycles...
